data.name: Hudhaifa
data.gender_notes: Hudhaifa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Hudhaifa carries the meaning “Friend of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hudhaifa usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes deep friendship and loyalty, especially towards one's faith and spiritual guide.
data.etymology: Hudhaifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hudhaifa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Hudhaifa bin Al-Yaman was a prominent companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who is recognized for his unwavering commitment and loyalty to Islam. His name is a reminder of the rich history of the Islamic community and the sacrifices made by its earliest members to spread the teachings of the Prophet. The name Hudhaifa also evokes images of bravery and courage, as Hudhaifa played a significant role in the Battle of Khaybar, where the Muslims were able to overcome their Jewish adversaries.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hudhaifa carries profound spiritual significance as it symbolizes steadfastness, loyalty, and devotion to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the teachings of Islam. Hudhaifa's life serves as an inspiring example of how one can remain dedicated to their faith and serve as a beacon of light in their community, even in the face of adversity. The name Hudhaifa encourages those who bear it to strive for excellence in their daily lives and to never waver in their faith, just as Hudhaifa remained steadfast in his commitment to the Prophet and Islam.
